rows.label: 总的来说，**19.2e 口径对账 + 强制覆盖探针（2026-11-04，0 更新；证据见 [19.2e 报告](../../reports/taiji_pa

criteria.C1_one_place: only taiji.sc_sfk.features changed (every byte offset instead of every other offset).  Address definition, anchor rule, capacity, merge, reject and rollback are untouched.
criteria.C2_arm_a_is_product: arm A runs AddressTable.read as shipped, i.e. offset-free features plus the DF=0 guard.  It is the only path wired into taiji/.
criteria.C3_arm_b_is_shadow: arm B is a shadow evaluation in this harness, computed from public table state (addresses, document frequency, unique features).  It is not wired into taiji/ and creates no second judge in the product.
criteria.C4_closed_neutral: with LivingCoreConfig() the 176-read battery is compared bit for bit against the baseline arrays captured before taiji/ was edited; any difference in fast bytes, probabilities, parameters, state_bytes, candidate_sha_v2 or store signature is a hard failure and the open arms do not run.
criteria.C5_corpus_frozen: the corpus snapshot is written and hashed before the first reading and is byte-identical to the anchor-count gate corpus; the run aborts if either moved.
criteria.C6_no_tuning: 0.60 usable line, denominators and verdict rules are frozen in the manifest before the run; no threshold, no leading margin, no retry with another rule.
criteria.V_holds: arm B: wrong == 0 AND usable >= 0.60 AND unknown 20/20 no_match AND ambiguous 20/20 -> offset_free_anchor_count_holds.
criteria.V_offset_not_the_cause: arm B still has a wrong pointer -> offset_not_the_cause: stop patching the address layer; representation and addressing have to be redefined together.
criteria.V_insufficient: arm B wrong == 0 but usable < 0.60 -> offset_free_insufficient: report the distribution, do not move the line.
criteria.V_inconclusive: neither branch reaches its condition cleanly.

disclosures: arm B is a shadow evaluation in this harness; AddressTable.read (arm A) is the only judge wired into taiji/, so the product keeps a single decision rule.
both arms read the same table, same writes, same queries; only the exit rule differs, which is what separates the offset question from the guard question.
unseen features are counted in both arms; in arm B they never enter the exit.
the unrelated set is a reading: a hard answer there is recorded, not scored.
similarity columns (top1/top2/margin) are diagnostics; no exit reads them.
